content:
Mike Chen: Heads up — seeing duplicated invoiceable events for some tenants when the routing priority TTL expires and fallback kicks in. Two chargeable events within ~30s. Not sure if this is dedupe window or routing metadata loss. Anyone seen this?

Jin Park: I traced a couple. Looks like original event carries trace_id but fallback event is missing origin_route and has a new event_id. Both share the same trace_id though. Example payloads below: 
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01",
  "trace_id": "tr_9f8a",
  "client_id": "tenant-42",
  "route": "primary",
  "routing_ttl_s": 30
}
{
  "event_id": "evt_02",
  "trace_id": "tr_9f8a",
  "client_id": "tenant-42",
  "route": "fallback",
  "routing_ttl_s": 0
}
```
So dedupe by event_id won't help. Dedupe by trace_id would, but not every producer guarantees trace_id. :thinking:

Ava Rao: Our ingest dedupe window is 30s right now. If fallback is reissued after TTL we hit outside the window and both events land. We could extend to 2m but that risks dropping legitimate separate requests from the same client. Also we already saw collisions when clients reuse traces for multi-call flows.

Oliver Ng: If we can get producers to add an origin header (like X-routing-origin: primary, routing_attempt:1) that'd be ideal. But changing lots of edge proxies is heavy. Alternative: at ingest-enrichment we can construct a fingerprint from (trace_id || token_prefix || request_path) and dedupe on that + time window. It's not perfect, but lowers duplicates without increasing global window.

Tara Liu: Short-term ops suggestion: create a dashboard metric for billing_duplicate_rate per tenant and alert when >0.5%. That lets us scope impact and rollback. Also propose a canary: extend dedupe window to 2m for one region/account subset and monitor invoice preview diff.

Mike Chen: Agreed on canary. We should also avoid silently dropping events for enterprise customers until we confirm. For canary we can surface duplicates in the invoice-preview pipeline (mark duplicates instead of deduping) so SRE + customer success can review.

Jin Park: I'll put up a quick ingest enrichment patch that emits a candidate_fingerprint field and a flag candidate_duplicate:true when we see matching fingerprint within 2m. No hard dedupe yet — emit annotation to pipeline so billing can filter/inspect.

Oliver Ng: Sounds good. Long term: add routing_attempt + origin_route to the routing proxy and make it part of canonical billing event schema. That will make dedupe deterministic. I'll open a tracker for infra changes.

Tara Liu: I'll add the dashboard + alert and coordinate with CS for affected tenants. Also cc @deploy-bot for scheduling the canary window. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for ingest-enrichment candidate_fingerprint feature at 3645010500 UTC to region us-west-2 (traffic slice: 5%).

Mike Chen: Thanks — next steps: Jin implements annotation (PR today), Oliver opens infra tracker, Tara creates dashboard + alert, Mike will draft customer comms for enterprise tenants. We'll reconvene after 24h of canary metrics. :pray:
